name: XTUSD
oneLiner: XTUSD is XT.com/XSC's MakerDAO-style vault dollar, minted against overcollateralized XTDao crypto vaults with limited public on-chain tooling for Pharos.
collateral: Overcollateralized XTDao vault collateral on XSC; issuer materials describe XT as the initial collateral asset with protocol support for additional collateral over time, but public live collateral composition remains hard to verify without XSC tooling.
pegMechanism: XTDao CDP: users mint XTUSD against overcollateralized vaults; risky vaults are auctioned to keep collateral above outstanding debt. Secondary market and account liquidity run through XT.com, and Pharos does not model a fiat cash redemption window.

mechanismArchetypeReview.reviewer: GPT SOL-NR-A wave6; Kimi T53 archetype re-verification
mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: XT.COM describes XTUSD as an XTDao vault system in which users mint debt against overcollateralized assets and unsafe vaults are auctioned. Those borrower-vault and liquidation mechanics establish the cdp archetype even though the current live collateral and control graph remain opaque. 2026-07-30 re-verification: at XSC block 47,929,909 the live MakerDAO DSS-style system is unchanged — the XTUSD token 0x1a6131ea… still has the DaiJoin 0xa57cde05… as its ward (wards = 1) and the Vat 0xf9d4810f… still returns live() = 1, so the borrower-vault mint path that grounds the cdp classification remains the live stabilization structure. A fresh v9 baseline replay compiles archetype = cdp with no missing-archetype gap.

sources.label: XSC public RPC (datarpc1.xsc.pub, XTUSD token wards and Vat live reads, block 47929909, 2026-07-30)

notices.title: Non-indexed issuance chain
notices.message: XTUSD primarily circulates on XSC, which is not EVM-indexed by Pharos. No on-chain contract is stored; supply and metadata are supplemented by external sources only.

notices.title: Redemption backstop not modeled
notices.message: XTUSD is tracked from market and issuer metadata, but Pharos has not source-reviewed a public holder redemption route for backstop scoring.
